user_problem: Behavior notes describe states and events, but permitted and forbidden transitions remain ambiguous.
unique_output: A transition table listing source state, event, guard, destination, effect, and unresolved cases.
required_input: Named states, event definitions, guard notes, and documented effects supplied as plain text.
critical_rule: Never invent a transition; mark combinations absent from the notes as unspecified rather than forbidden.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is document-consistency-check; this constructs an executable-style behavioral model instead of comparing assertions across documents.
acceptance_scenario: Input states Draft and Published, event publish allowed only from Draft, effect timestamp set. Output includes Draft+publish→Published with the guard and effect, while Published+publish is unspecified.
